      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- Parámetros Físicos Reales ---\n",
        "E_ELEC_PER_BIT_PER_M = 0.1e-12\n",
        "E_ELEC_FIXED = 0.0\n",
        "E_OPTICAL_PER_BIT_PER_M = 0.001e-12\n",
        "E_EOE_CONVERSION = 1.0e-12\n",
        "E_LASER_BIAS = 0.5e-12\n",
        "\n",
        "ALPHA_OVERHEAD = 0.3\n",
        "ACC_THRESHOLD = 0.95\n",
        "BETA_PENALTY = 150\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- Funciones de Costo ---\n",
        "def energy_electrical(distance_m, data_bits):\n",
        "    return E_ELEC_FIXED + (E_ELEC_PER_BIT_PER_M * distance_m * data_bits)\n",
        "\n",
        "def energy_optical(distance_m, data_bits):\n",
        "    conversion_cost = (E_EOE_CONVERSION + E_LASER_BIAS) * data_bits\n",
        "    transmission_cost = E_OPTICAL_PER_BIT_PER_M * distance_m * data_bits\n",
        "    return conversion_cost + transmission_cost\n",
        "\n",
        "def paae_cost_fotonic(energy, abstraction_level, signal_quality):\n",
        "    overhead = ALPHA_OVERHEAD * abstraction_level * 1e-12\n",
        "    quality_penalty = max(0, (ACC_THRESHOLD - signal_quality) * BETA_PENALTY * 1e-12)\n",
        "    return energy + overhead + quality_penalty\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- Simulación ---\n",
        "print(\"🔬 Ejecutando simulación PAADE-Fotónico...\")\n",
        "distances = np.logspace(-3, 1, 50)\n",
        "data_volume = 1e9\n",
        "results = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for d in distances:\n",
        "    e_elec = energy_electrical(d, data_volume)\n",
        "    e_opt = energy_optical(d, data_volume)\n",
        "    quality_elec = max(0.85, 0.99 - (d * 0.01))\n",
        "    quality_opt = max(0.97, 0.999 - (d * 0.001))\n",
        "\n",
        "    cost_elec = paae_cost_fotonic(e_elec, 0, quality_elec)\n",
        "    cost_opt = paae_cost_fotonic(e_opt, 50, quality_opt)\n",
        "\n",
        "    results.append({\n",
        "        'Distancia_m': d,\n",
        "        'Energía_Eléctrica_J': e_elec,\n",
        "        'Energía_Óptica_J': e_opt,\n",
        "        'Costo_PAADE_Eléctrico': cost_elec,\n",
        "        'Costo_PAADE_Óptico': cost_opt,\n",
        "        'Calidad_Eléctrica': quality_elec,\n",
        "        'Calidad_Óptica': quality_opt\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Encontrar punto de cruce\n",
        "crossover_idx = np.where(df['Costo_PAADE_Óptico'] < df['Costo_PAADE_Eléctrico'])[0]\n",
        "if len(crossover_idx) > 0:\n",
        "    crossover_point = df.iloc[crossover_idx[0]]\n",
        "    print(f\"✅ PUNTO DE CRUCE: {crossover_point['Distancia_m']*1000:.2f} mm\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"No se encontró cruce en este rango.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Gráficos\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n",
        "plt.plot(df['Distancia_m']*1000, df['Energía_Eléctrica_J']*1e12, 'o-', label='Eléctrico')\n",
        "plt.plot(df['Distancia_m']*1000, df['Energía_Óptica_J']*1e12, 's--', label='Óptico (IR)')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Distancia (mm)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Energía (pJ)')\n",
        "plt.title('Energía de Transmisión')\n",
        "plt.xscale('log')\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)\n",
        "plt.plot(df['Distancia_m']*1000, df['Costo_PAADE_Eléctrico']*1e12, 'o-', label='PAADE Eléctrico')\n",
        "plt.plot(df['Distancia_m']*1000, df['Costo_PAADE_Óptico']*1e12, 's--', label='PAADE Óptico')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Distancia (mm)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Costo Total PAADE (pJ)')\n",
        "plt.title('Costo Total PAADE (con Overhead)')\n",
        "plt.xscale('log')\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# === PARÁMETROS FÍSICOS REALES (fuentes: IEEE JSTQE 2025, Intel IEDM 2024) ===\n",
        "E_elec_per_m = 0.1e-12        # J/bit/m (cobre, interconexión on-chip)\n",
        "E_opt_per_m = 0.001e-12       # J/bit/m (fibra IR @1550nm)\n",
        "E_conv = 1.0e-12              # J/bit (conversión E/O/E, tecnología 2026)\n",
        "E_laser = 0.5e-12             # J/bit (polarización láser, fijo)\n",
        "B = 1e9                       # 1 Gbit de datos\n",
        "alpha_opt = 0.3e-12           # J (overhead gestión espectral PAADE)\n",
        "alpha_elec = 0.05e-12         # J (overhead gestión eléctrica PAADE)\n",
        "\n",
        "# === FUNCIÓN DE COSTO PAADE EXTENDIDA ===\n",
        "def costo_electrico(d):\n",
        "    return (E_elec_per_m * d * B) + alpha_elec\n",
        "\n",
        "def costo_optico(d):\n",
        "    return ((E_conv + E_laser) * B) + (E_opt_per_m * d * B) + alpha_opt\n",
        "\n",
        "# === CALCULAR PUNTO DE CRUCE ANALÍTICO ===\n",
        "# Condición: costo_optico(d) < costo_electrico(d)\n",
        "# Despejando d:\n",
        "numerador = (E_conv + E_laser) * B + alpha_opt - alpha_elec\n",
        "denominador = B * (E_elec_per_m - E_opt_per_m)\n",
        "d_crossover = numerador / denominador if denominador > 0 else np.inf\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"🔬 Parámetros: E_conv={E_conv*1e12:.1f} pJ/bit, B={B/1e9:.0f} Gbit\")\n",
        "print(f\"📏 Distancia crítica de cruce: {d_crossover*1000:.1f} mm ({d_crossover:.2f} m)\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# === INTERPRETACIÓN CORRECTA ===\n",
        "umbral_datacenter = 10.0  # metros (típico intra-rack)\n",
        "viable = d_crossover < umbral_datacenter\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\n📊 Viabilidad en datacenter (distancias < {umbral_datacenter} m):\")\n",
        "if viable:\n",
        "    print(\"   ✅ ÓPTICO viable: el cruce ocurre ANTES del límite típico\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"   ❌ ELÉCTRICO sigue siendo mejor: el cruce está MÁS ALLÁ del rango útil\")\n",
        "    print(f\"      (se necesitaría >{d_crossover:.1f} m para que óptico gane)\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# === GRÁFICO SIMPLE Y CLARO ===\n",
        "distancias = np.logspace(-3, 2, 200)  # 1mm a 100m\n",
        "costos_elec = [costo_electrico(d)*1e12 for d in distancias]  # convertir a pJ\n",
        "costos_opt = [costo_optico(d)*1e12 for d in distancias]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "plt.plot(distancias*1000, costos_elec, 'o-', label='Eléctrico (Cobre)', linewidth=2)\n",
        "plt.plot(distancias*1000, costos_opt, 's--', label='Óptico (IR 1550nm)', linewidth=2)\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=d_crossover*1000, color='gold', linestyle=':', label=f'Cruce: {d_crossover*1000:.0f} mm')\n",
        "plt.axvline(x=umbral_datacenter*1000, color='gray', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label=f'Límite datacenter: {umbral_datacenter} m')\n",
        "plt.xscale('log')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Distancia (mm)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Costo PAADE (pJ)')\n",
        "plt.title('PAADE-Fotónico: ¿Cuándo conviene usar luz infrarroja?')\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# === BARRIDO RÁPIDO: ¿Qué pasa si mejora la tecnología? ===\n",
        "print(f\"\\n🔮 Proyección si mejora la conversión E/O/E:\")\n",
        "print(f\"{'E_conv (pJ/bit)':<18} | {'d_crossover (m)':<16} | {'Viabilidad'}\")\n",
        "print(\"-\"*50)\n",
        "for e_conv_pJ in [1.0, 0.7, 0.5, 0.3, 0.2]:\n",
        "    E_conv_test = e_conv_pJ * 1e-12\n",
        "    num = (E_conv_test + E_laser) * B + alpha_opt - alpha_elec\n",
        "    d_cross = num / denominador if denominador > 0 else np.inf\n",
        "    viable = \"✅ Sí\" if d_cross < umbral_datacenter else \"❌ No\"\n",
        "    print(f\"{e_conv_pJ:<18.1f} | {d_cross:<16.1f} | {viable}\")"
      ],
